analytic_results: For arbitrary finite mixtures, B_can(M)-sum_y lambda_y B_can(P_y) = sum_A M(A) D_2(P(Y|S=A) || P(Y|S superset A)).
At the uniform subset law, the Hessian in relative direction r is -(1/ln2) E[(r-Kr)^2], where K is upper-cone averaging.
scope_notes: The exact witness refutes only the proposed raw payment with coefficient 2/ln2 (indeed any coefficient at most 3).
The finite and heuristic searches do not establish a universal direct-payment constant.
Neither result proves or refutes full FEI.
